feature: Module 025 — in-app preview of the generated SOW/GSD (Stage 3)

killSwitch.note: Preview endpoints 404 and no preview control renders unless this is set to true. Run this smoke against an environment where it is true.

preconditions: Signed in as a Solution Architect who owns at least one engagement.
One active (non-confirmed) engagement with a generated draft, and one confirmed engagement, both owned by the signed-in user.

flows.name: preview control is hidden when the kill-switch is OFF

steps.note: Sign in and open Module 025 SOW & GSD Workspace with the flag OFF.
No preview control renders; download buttons unchanged.

flows.name: draft preview renders SOW sections and the DRAFT badge

steps.openEngagement: active engagement with a generated draft

steps.note: DRAFT — not approved badge is shown.
Phase headings render in order Plan → Design → Implement → Validate → Release.

flows.name: draft GSD preview shows sheet tabs and a cell grid

steps.note: Selected sheet renders as a cell grid.
Switching tabs re-fetches that sheet's cells.
The confirmed .docx download still works and is byte-for-byte unchanged by this feature.
